history.visible_defect: First actual render made acquisition read too close to a farthest-reach snatch and the approach body arrived too late relative to the hand, weakening the causal body-before-grip setup.
history.correction: Mutate the SAME C013 body: move A materially closer during C013-K1, keep payload fully stationary through no-contact approach, close C013-K2 with a bent body-supported reach, and add deterministic pre-key approach/carry/load connective frames that retain prior semantic ownership until the authored join.

history.visible_result: Fresh inspection of all 46 final decoded frames shows body-first asymmetric approach, payload static before latch, acquisition inside committed reach, pinned rear-root carry/load, cross-body LOAD_MAX, a held release threshold with custody intact, explicit release fork, payload lead only after release, opposing recoil, secondary-lag overshoot and displaced recovery debt. No mannequin carry, equal-spacing tween, premature payload float, reverse interpolation or idle reset remains.

noodle_queen.taste: PASS: the cross-body windup turns the generic payload into a visibly expensive weight; the held rear pin and long thrown arc give the motion a specific crooked attitude.
